name: FMA: A Dataset for Music Analysis
description: FMA (Free Music Archive) is an open music analysis and information retrieval benchmark. Comprising 106,574 full-length audio tracks (343 days of audio) from 16,341 artists across 161 musical genres, it includes pre-extracted audio features, full track metadata, tags, and hierarchical genre labels. Provided in nested subsets of increasing scale (fma_small: 8,000 clips; fma_medium: 25,000 clips; fma_large and fma_full: 106,574 tracks), it benchmarks music genre classification, retrieval, and auto-tagging.

license.name: CC BY 4.0 (Metadata) / Varied Creative Commons (Audio)
license.notes: Dataset metadata and features are licensed under CC BY 4.0 and code under MIT; underlying audio tracks are subject to diverse artist-selected Creative Commons and public domain licenses (including non-commercial and no-derivatives variants), so commercial usability depends on individual track terms.
